messages:
mira: Quick heads up — we ran a canary for the new prefetch orchestration + regional-fallback-v2 in eu-west last night. 48h sample, ~212k requests. Preliminary win: p50 ~ -12ms, p95 ~ -28%, estimated cost per 1M tokens -18%. Landing flag set to canary. :tada:
ops-bot: canary run summary: traffic=212,487 requests; errors=0.12%; p50 baseline=38ms -> canary=26ms; p95 baseline=220ms -> canary=158ms; cost_delta=-18.1% (est). No throttles tripped.
sam_k: beautiful. where's the detailed bench doc / graphs?
mira: gist + dashboard: https://redwood.internal/gists/prefetch-orch-3126 and perf dashboard -> "prefetch-orch/3126". includes heatmaps, per-model breakdown, and raw traces.
anya: did we run the full eval suites? any quality regressions on long-context prompts?
mira: ran chat-e2e + embeddings-smoke. tiny regression on very long contexts (>=2k tokens): EM down 0.6% absolute for one edge model. logged INF-879. seems tied to more aggressive prefetch TTL for cold-prefixes.
devon: rollout plan? can we do an A/B canary (10% -> 50%) with auto-rollback if p95 spikes >10%?
mira: yep. added rollout policy to the canary config: ```yaml
rollout:
  type: canary
  steps:
    - pct: 10
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 50
      duration: 2h
  rollback_on: p95_latency_increase_pct: 10
  fallback: regional-fallback-v2
```
jeff: i can own the ops watch — scheduling maintenance/watch window 07:00 PST tomorrow. i'll monitor traces and can trigger rollback.
sam_k: i'll draft the release note and cost estimate for finance. please include a per-model cost delta (esp the edge model that regressed).
anya: added an automated eval job to the perf dashboard to monitor the LM-chat-suite and MM-embed suites against the canary. linked INF-879 to the job.
mira: thanks all — launching canary 07:00 PST tomorrow (10% traffic first). will post 24h follow-up with full numbers and decide on 50% step. :rocket:
